name: Long-Context Reasoning Benchmark for LLM-Based WebAgents
description: A benchmark to evaluate the long context reasoning capabilities of WebAgents through sequentially dependent subtasks requiring retrieval and application of information from extended interaction histories up to 150,000 tokens.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for long-context WebAgent reasoning, so community adoption is still limited and results are likely preliminary.
notes: Simulates multi-session user interactions with injected irrelevant tasks; evaluates four popular models showing performance degradation with longer contexts.
